Follows links from a meta nofollow page when robots directives are disabled while retaining detection fields

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxDepth: 1, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages.length);
  console.log(result.pages[0].nofollowDetected);
  console.log(result.pages[0].noindexDetected);
  console.log(result.pages[1].nofollowDetected);
}

void main();
```
